dog.description_text:
Meet Goalie 🐾

Found stray in Georgia and transported to NYC, Goalie’s foster family got a surprise soon after: she was pregnant. Not long after, she welcomed 5 puppies of her own — and just like that, this little girl became a mom before she’d even finished being a puppy herself (she’s still under 2!).

Don’t let the “mom” title fool you, though. Goalie is pure goofball energy — constantly trying to rope her two foster brothers (each about 3x her size) into play, and if her babies will let her, she’s got all 5 of them roped in too. Mornings are her best look: wiggly, snuggly, and giving off serious sea otter vibes with that sweet face of hers.

Underneath the silliness is a genuinely fearless, independent little girl who isn’t scared of a thing. Goalie’s proven she can handle whatever comes her way — now she just needs a family (and maybe a comfy couch) to call her own.

Personality & Characteristics:

My foster dog is good with: All dogs and people!
My foster dog is: House trained, Low shed
3 Keywords for your pup: Snuggly, silly, sweet

Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high energy): 3

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: Quiet, just barks at noises outside our door!

Walking Manners: Great on leash!

Appetite: can always eat 🤣

Favorite Things: play time with her foster brothers and babies! Fooooooodddd!

Commands/Tricks: Making 5 beautiful little puppies

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
